plan.notes: Official Utah Tech University 2025-2026 Catalog, Criminal Justice AS graduation plan text PDF. SOURCE ANOMALY: the program curriculum page lists 60 credits, but the 2025-2026 graduation plan prints 'Total Hours 59' and the semester totals (15 / 13 / 15 / 16 = 59) sum to 59 — transcribed faithfully as printed with total_credits 59. Course titles verified against the official 2025-2026 CJ AS program curriculum text: CJ 1010 Introduction to Criminal Justice; CJ 1330 Criminal Law; CJ 1340 Criminal Investigation; CJ 2350 Laws of Evidence; MATH 1040 Introduction to Statistics (MA); ENGL 1010 Introduction to Writing (EN); ENGL 2010 Interm Writing Selected Topics: (EN). 'MATH 0980 (if needed)' is a choice placeholder (4 credits); title not shown in the plan. 'CJ elective (CJ course)' slots (numbered 1-4) are choice placeholders; the program requires a minimum of 9 credits in any Utah Tech Criminal Justice courses other than CJ 4890R. Prerequisites not populated from the plan; see official course descriptions in the 2025-2026 catalog.
